events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates. Which track from the album means the most to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's enduring career
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo work, his music has truly stood the test of time. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: Original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music and marking a quarter-century milestone.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you downloaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Celebrating 007
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating decades of espionage, iconic gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, his genius has given us so many laughs. What's your top John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Which track from its diverse collection is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's incredible talent
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's lasting peace
angles.copy: On this day, we pause to remember John Lennon. His music and spirit continue to advocate for peace and understanding across the globe.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The visionary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's artistic genius
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and artistry of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. His influence on music, fashion, and culture is immeasurable. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're honouring the one and only Elvis Presley. His impact on music and pop culture is still felt today. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar icon Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's the Led Zeppelin track that showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of rock and pop, Sir Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's career
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, his career has been incredible. What's your favourite Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness frontman's day
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! A true British institution. What's your favourite tune to skank to?
